source: The Solar System master prompt (docs/SOLAR-SYSTEM.md), Part 2 section A2: the global assumptions under every projection, each with the level that replaces it. The dated tables under tables are the repository's existing year-versioned files; nothing is copied.
confidenceNote: A metric computed on any default is rough by definition. Every default carries its own source and as-of date.
note: Read by the engine (step 2). value is the default; replacedBy names the levels whose arrival replaces it. tables maps each rule domain the prompt calls data/tax-tables.json and data/benefit-tables.json onto the existing file and its shared/reference.js key, so no limit, bracket or threshold is inlined twice.

realReturn.note: One declared default, real not nominal: the likely band of data/return_bands.json, the same figure the opening plans on.
realReturn.replacedByNote: A13 allocation blend (expectedReturn), then A20 holdings, shaped by the Y16 Triple D pick.

withdrawalRate.note: The 4% convention (Bengen 1994, the Trinity study) fitted to thirty-year windows. planHorizon past thirty years shows the Big ERN lens (3.25 to 3.5%) beside it; the opening screen plans on 3.5% for that reason (data/opening.json).
withdrawalRate.replacedByNote: Y28 plan horizon and A30 drawdown approach.
withdrawalRate.source: SPEC.md section 12, item 2 (resolved: 4% SWR); data/opening.json for the long-horizon figure

inflation.note: Declared once: all math is in today's dollars, so the working inflation figure is zero and every return is real. The nominal view is a switch (data/features.json showNominal).
inflation.replacedByNote: E30 personal inflation, applied to the FI-phase spending only.
inflation.source: Principle 0.3 item 8 and D1 "Real vs. nominal returns"

incomeGrowth.unit: rate a year, real, by career stage (Y12)
incomeGrowth.note: A real raise pace by stage: three, two and one percent over inflation. The opening uses 2% for its save-half-of-every-raise lever (data/opening.json raiseRateReal).
incomeGrowth.replacedByNote: I13 expected raise, I14 three-year history.
incomeGrowth.source: Convention, in line with data/opening.json raiseRateReal; not a measurement

emergencyFundMonths.note: 3 if I3 says steady, 6 if variable.
emergencyFundMonths.source: data/ratio_benchmarks.json emergency fund band (3 to 6 months)

rothIra.note: contributions reachable any time, growth locked until 59.5

traditionalIra.note: locked until 59.5 outside the exceptions in data/early_access_rules_2026.json

401k.note: locked until 59.5; Rule of 55 in the early-access table

457b.note: penalty-free after leaving the employer, which matters for the bridge

hsa.note: medical only before 65, any use after

old_401k.note: a plan at a former employer

529.note: education only, or the Roth rollover rules

homeEquity.note: locked: it does not pay for groceries

vehicle.note: sellable in weeks, at a loss

iBonds.note: locked for a year, then reachable with a small penalty for five

accountDefaults.note: The liquidity tier and the tax type implied by the account type alone. This is how liquidity rate and bridge years are revealed at Tier 2 without a liquidity question (section 1.13). The keys match Schema.ACCOUNT_TYPES where a type exists there.
accountDefaults.replacedByNote: A10 tax type confirm, A11 liquidity tier confirm.
accountDefaults.source: Convention; the penalty and age rules are in data/early_access_rules_2026.json

taxRates.note: Read from the dated bracket tables by Y2 state and T4 filing status. Nothing is inlined here.

benefitDefaults.note: Match formulas, HSA limits and contribution limits are read from the dated tables; refreshed once a year.
benefitDefaults.source: data/match_defaults.json, data/irs_limits_2026.json, data/se_tax_2026.json, data/aca_2026.json, data/benefit_cliffs_2026.json, data/early_access_rules_2026.json, data/student_loan_conventions.json

federalBrackets.holds: federal brackets, the standard deduction and the capital gains thresholds by filing status

effectiveTaxRates.holds: rough effective rates by income and state, for the Sketch band

seTax.holds: self-employment tax rates, the wage base, the safe harbor and the quarterly dates

aca.holds: marketplace subsidy rules and the poverty line multiples

benefitCliffs.holds: the income levels where a benefit drops

earlyAccess.holds: the 59.5 rule, the penalty, SEPP, the Rule of 55, the conversion seasoning years

studentLoans.holds: income-driven repayment shape, forgiveness years, the interest deduction band

mortgageRates.holds: current market mortgage rates for the refinance check

ratioBenchmarks.holds: the default band per ratio (good and warn edges)

wealthMultiplier.holds: the Money Guy wealth multiplier path

fooRules.holds: the order of operations thresholds and ladder

returnBands.holds: the planning return bands behind Triple D

levers.holds: the single lever library the sun ranks
